name: Minecraft: FTB
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Any Feed The Beast modpack, by its ID and version. Installs the pack's server files, each checked against FTB's checksum, with the Minecraft version and mod loader it needs, and keeps the files you change across updates.
startup: read -r need max 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; read -r launch 2>/dev/null < .raptor-launch || { echo "The modpack isn't installed. Reinstall the server."; exit 1; }; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" -v max="$max" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; low = have + 0 < need + 0; high = max != "" && have + 0 > max + 0; if (low || high) { want = (max == "") ? need " or newer" : (max == need) ? need : need " to " max; printf "This modpack needs Java %s, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", want, have, low ? need : max; exit 1 } exit }' && exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true $launch nogui

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: FTB. Installs a Feed The Beast modpack: its server files
# (each checked against FTB's checksum) and the Minecraft version and mod
# loader it was made for. Files you've changed and your worlds are kept;
# files the pack drops on an update are removed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
sum() { "${1}sum" "$2" | cut -d' ' -f1; }

# Everything new is put together in .raptor-stage first and only moved
# into place once all of it has downloaded and checked out.
stage=/mnt/server/.raptor-stage
rm -rf "$stage" /mnt/server/.raptor-jre
mkdir -p "$stage/files"
trap 'rm -rf "$stage" /mnt/server/.raptor-jre' EXIT
trap 'echo "The install stopped at line $LINENO of its script. Nothing more was changed. Reinstall to try again."' ERR
: > "$stage/list"

# want <path> <url> <sha1|sha256|sha512> <hash>: a file the pack needs.
want() {
    local rel=${1#./}
    case "/$rel/" in
        */../*|*/./*|//*) fail "The pack has a file outside the server folder ($1), so it wasn't installed." ;;
    esac
    [ -n "$2" ] || fail "The pack's file $rel has no download link, so the pack can't be installed."
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$3" "$4" "$2" "$rel" >> "$stage/list"
}

# overrides <zip> <folder>: the files in that folder of the pack's zip.
overrides() {
    local tmp="$stage/unzip"
    rm -rf "$tmp"
    mkdir -p "$tmp"
    unzip -qo "$1" "$2/*" -d "$tmp" 2>/dev/null || true
    if [ -d "$tmp/$2" ]; then
        cp -a "$tmp/$2/." "$stage/files/"
    fi
    rm -rf "$tmp"
}

# ---- The pack, from FTB. ----
api=https://api.feed-the-beast.com/v1/modpacks/public/modpack
project="${FTB_MODPACK_ID:-}"
if [ -z "$project" ] && [ -n "${FTB_SEARCH_TERM:-}" ]; then
    project=$(get "$api/search/8?term=$(jq -rn --arg t "$FTB_SEARCH_TERM" '$t | @uri')" | jq -r '.packs[0] // empty') || true
    [ -n "$project" ] || fail "FTB has no modpack matching \"$FTB_SEARCH_TERM\". Set Modpack ID instead."
fi
[[ "$project" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || fail "Set Modpack ID to the pack's number on FTB's site (such as 126), then reinstall."
pack=$(get "$api/$project") || fail "FTB has no modpack $project, or it can't be reached right now. Check the Modpack ID and reinstall."
[ "$(jq -r .status <<<"$pack")" = success ] || fail "FTB has no modpack $project. Check the Modpack ID and reinstall."
pack_name=$(jq -r .name <<<"$pack")
want_id="${FTB_MODPACK_VERSION_ID:-}"
want_name="${FTB_VERSION_STRING:-latest}"
if [ -n "$want_id" ]; then
    vid=$(jq -r --arg v "$want_id" '.versions[] | select((.id | tostring) == $v) | .id' <<<"$pack")
    [ -n "$vid" ] || fail "$pack_name has no version ID $want_id. Clear Version ID to use Version instead."
elif [ "$want_name" = latest ]; then
    vid=$(jq -r '(([.versions[] | select(.type == "release")] | sort_by(.updated) | last) // (.versions | sort_by(.updated) | last)) | .id // empty' <<<"$pack")
    [ -n "$vid" ] || fail "$pack_name has no versions to install."
else
    vid=$(jq -r --arg v "$want_name" '[.versions[] | select(.name == $v)] | last | .id // empty' <<<"$pack")
    [ -n "$vid" ] || fail "$pack_name has no version $want_name. Set Version to latest, or to one of its versions, such as $(jq -r '.versions | sort_by(.updated) | last | .name' <<<"$pack")."
fi
version_json=$(get "$api/$project/$vid") || fail "FTB can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
pack_version=$(jq -r '.name' <<<"$version_json")

# The version's files, as FTB's API lists them: everything but client-only
# files, each with its SHA-1. A CurseForge pack's own zip brings its
# overrides (configs, scripts) with it.
override_zips=()
override_dir=overrides
targets() { jq -r --arg t "$1" '[.targets[] | select(.type == $t)][0] | .'"$2"' // empty' <<<"$version_json"; }
mc=$(targets game version)
loader=$(targets modloader name)
lver=$(targets modloader version)
[ -z "${from_server_pack:-}" ] || version_json=$(jq -c '.files = []' <<<"$version_json")
while IFS=$'\t' read -r kind path name url sha; do
    rel=${path#./}
    rel=${rel%/}
    rel="${rel:+$rel/}$name"
    if [ "$kind" = cf-extract ]; then
        echo "Downloading the pack's own files"
        curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$stage/pack.zip" "$url"
        [ "$(sum sha1 "$stage/pack.zip")" = "$sha" ] || fail "The pack's download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
        override_dir=$(unzip -p "$stage/pack.zip" manifest.json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.overrides // "overrides"' 2>/dev/null || echo overrides)
        override_zips+=("$stage/pack.zip")
    else
        algo=sha1
        [ -n "$sha" ] || algo=none
        want "$rel" "$url" "$algo" "$sha"
    fi
done < <(jq -r '.files[] | select(.clientonly | not) | [.type, .path, .name, (.url // ""), (.sha1 // .hashes.sha1 // "")] | @tsv' <<<"$version_json")

# ---- Check the Minecraft version and loader before changing anything. ----
[ -n "${mc:-}" ] && [ -n "${loader:-}" ] && [ -n "${lver:-}" ] || fail "The pack doesn't say which Minecraft version and mod loader it needs, so it can't be installed."
case "$loader" in
    forge) Loader=Forge ;; neoforge) Loader=NeoForge ;; fabric) Loader=Fabric ;; quilt) Loader=Quilt ;;
    *) fail "The pack uses the $loader loader, which isn't supported (Forge, NeoForge, Fabric and Quilt are)." ;;
esac
older() { [ "$1" != "$2" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$1" "$2" | sort -V | head -n1)" = "$1" ]; }
manifest=$(get https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json) || fail "Mojang can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
mc_url=$(jq -r --arg v "$mc" '.versions[] | select(.id == $v) | .url' <<<"$manifest")
[ -n "$mc_url" ] || fail "The pack is for Minecraft $mc, which Mojang doesn't list."
mc_json=$(get "$mc_url") || fail "Mojang can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
need=$(jq -r '.javaVersion.majorVersion // 8' <<<"$mc_json")
max=""
case "$loader" in
    forge|neoforge)
        # Older Forge runs only on the Java it was made for.
        if older "$mc" 1.17; then max=8; elif older "$mc" 1.20.5; then max=21; fi ;;
esac

# server.jar <name>: Mojang's server jar for $mc, checked.
vanilla() {
    local url sha
    url=$(jq -r '.downloads.server.url // empty' <<<"$mc_json")
    sha=$(jq -r '.downloads.server.sha1 // empty' <<<"$mc_json")
    [ -n "$url" ] || fail "Mojang has no server for Minecraft $mc."
    if [ -f "$1" ] && [ "$(sum sha1 "$1")" = "$sha" ]; then return; fi
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$1.new" "$url"
    [ "$(sum sha1 "$1.new")" = "$sha" ] || { rm -f "$1.new"; fail "Minecraft's server jar didn't match Mojang's checksum. Reinstall to try again."; }
    mv -f "$1.new" "$1"
}
# A Java to run the loader's installer with, removed afterwards.
jre() {
    local a info link sha j=$need
    [ "$j" != 16 ] || j=17
    case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) a=x64 ;; aarch64|arm64) a=aarch64 ;; *) fail "This CPU isn't supported." ;; esac
    info=$(get "https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/$j/hotspot?architecture=$a&image_type=jre&os=linux&vendor=eclipse") || fail "Adoptium can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    link=$(jq -r '.[0].binary.package.link // empty' <<<"$info")
    sha=$(jq -r '.[0].binary.package.checksum // empty' <<<"$info")
    [ -n "$link" ] || fail "There's no Java $j download for this CPU."
    mkdir -p /mnt/server/.raptor-jre
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$stage/jre.tgz" "$link"
    [ "$(sum sha256 "$stage/jre.tgz")" = "$sha" ] || fail "The Java download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    tar -xzf "$stage/jre.tgz" -C /mnt/server/.raptor-jre --strip-components=1
    rm -f "$stage/jre.tgz"
    java=/mnt/server/.raptor-jre/bin/java
}
# maven <metadata url> <version...>: the first of those versions it has.
maven() {
    local meta v
    meta=$(get "$1") || fail "The loader's repository can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    shift
    for v in "$@"; do
        if grep -qF "<version>$v</version>" <<<"$meta"; then echo "$v"; return; fi
    done
}
# installer <url>: download a loader installer, checked against its .sha1.
installer() {
    local sha
    sha=$(get "$1.sha1" | cut -c1-40) || fail "The loader's repository can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$stage/installer.jar" "$1"
    [ "$(sum sha1 "$stage/installer.jar")" = "$sha" ] || fail "The loader's installer didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
}

case "$loader" in
    fabric)
        curl -fsS -A "$ua" -o /dev/null "https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader/$mc/$lver" 2>/dev/null ||
            fail "Fabric has no loader $lver for Minecraft $mc." ;;
    quilt)
        curl -fsS -A "$ua" -o /dev/null "https://meta.quiltmc.org/v3/versions/loader/$mc/$lver" 2>/dev/null ||
            fail "Quilt has no loader $lver for Minecraft $mc." ;;
    forge)
        v=$(maven https://maven.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/maven-metadata.xml "$mc-$lver" "$mc-$lver-$mc" "$lver")
        [ -n "$v" ] || fail "Forge has no version $lver for Minecraft $mc." ;;
    neoforge)
        if [ "$mc" = 1.20.1 ]; then
            path=forge
            v=$(maven https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged/forge/maven-metadata.xml "1.20.1-${lver#1.20.1-}")
        else
            path=neoforge
            v=$(maven https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged/neoforge/maven-metadata.xml "$lver")
        fi
        [ -n "$v" ] || fail "NeoForge has no version $lver for Minecraft $mc." ;;
esac

# ---- Download what isn't here yet, eight at a time, each checked. ----
fetch() {
    local out="$stage/files/$4"
    mkdir -p "${out%/*}"
    # Some links have spaces or brackets in them, as CurseForge's do.
    if ! curl -fsSLg --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$out" "${3// /%20}"; then
        echo "Couldn't download $4."
        return 1
    fi
    if [ "$1" != none ] && [ "$(sum "$1" "$out")" != "$2" ]; then
        echo "$4 didn't match its checksum."
        return 1
    fi
}
: > "$stage/present"
total=$(wc -l < "$stage/list")
[ "$total" = 0 ] || echo "Checking the pack's $total files"
jobs=0
bad=0
while IFS=$'\t' read -r algo hash url rel; do
    if [ "$algo" != none ] && [ -f "$rel" ] && [ ! -L "$rel" ] && [ "$(sum "$algo" "$rel")" = "$hash" ]; then
        printf '%s  %s\n' "$(sum sha1 "$rel")" "$rel" >> "$stage/present"
        continue
    fi
    fetch "$algo" "$hash" "$url" "$rel" &
    jobs=$((jobs + 1))
    if [ "$jobs" -ge 8 ]; then
        wait -n || bad=1
        jobs=$((jobs - 1))
    fi
done < "$stage/list"
while [ "$jobs" -gt 0 ]; do
    wait -n || bad=1
    jobs=$((jobs - 1))
done
[ "$bad" = 0 ] || fail "Some of the pack's files didn't download. Nothing was changed. Reinstall to try again."
# Overrides go over the downloads, as the pack intends.
for z in "${override_zips[@]}"; do
    overrides "$z" "${override_dir:-overrides}"
    [ -z "${server_override_dir:-}" ] || overrides "$z" "$server_override_dir"
done
rm -rf "$stage/files/resourcepacks" "$stage/files/shaderpacks" "$stage/files/eula.txt" "$stage/files/options.txt" "$stage/files/servers.dat"

# ---- Move the pack into place, keeping what the owner changed. ----
# .raptor-pack lists each file the last install put here, with its hash.
# A file still as the pack left it is updated or removed with the pack; a
# file someone changed is kept (mods are always the pack's), and worlds
# are never touched.
world=""
[ ! -f server.properties ] || world=$(sed -n 's/^level-name=//p' server.properties | tail -n1)
world=${world:-world}
declare -A old=() new=()
first=1
if [ -f .raptor-pack ]; then
    first=0
    while IFS= read -r line; do old["${line:42}"]=${line:0:40}; done < .raptor-pack
fi
while IFS= read -r line; do
    new["${line:42}"]=${line:0:40}
done < <(cat "$stage/present"; cd "$stage/files" && find . -type f -printf '%P\0' | xargs -0 -r sha1sum)

added=0 updated=0 removed=0
kept=()
for rel in "${!new[@]}"; do
    src="$stage/files/$rel"
    if [ "${rel#"$world"/}" != "$rel" ]; then
        # The pack's world: only for a server that has none yet.
        unset 'new[$rel]'
        [ ! -f "$src" ] || [ -f "$world/level.dat" ] || { mkdir -p "${rel%/*}"; mv -f "$src" "$rel"; }
        continue
    fi
    [ -f "$src" ] || continue
    if [ -L "$rel" ] || [ -d "$rel" ]; then
        kept+=("$rel")
    elif [ -f "$rel" ]; then
        cur=$(sum sha1 "$rel")
        if [ "$cur" = "${new[$rel]}" ]; then
            :
        elif [ "${old[$rel]:-}" = "$cur" ] || [ "${rel#mods/}" != "$rel" ]; then
            mv -f "$src" "$rel"
            updated=$((updated + 1))
        else
            kept+=("$rel")
        fi
    else
        [ "${rel%/*}" = "$rel" ] || mkdir -p "${rel%/*}"
        mv -f "$src" "$rel"
        added=$((added + 1))
    fi
done
for rel in "${!old[@]}"; do
    [ -z "${new[$rel]+x}" ] || continue
    if [ -f "$rel" ] && [ ! -L "$rel" ] && [ "$(sum sha1 "$rel")" = "${old[$rel]}" ]; then
        rm -f "$rel"
        removed=$((removed + 1))
    fi
done
# A first install over existing files (another egg's, say): mods the pack
# doesn't have would load next to its own, so they're set aside.
moved=0
if [ "$first" = 1 ] && [ -d mods ]; then
    for f in mods/*.jar; do
        [ -f "$f" ] && [ -z "${new[$f]+x}" ] || continue
        mkdir -p mods.old
        mv -f "$f" mods.old/
        moved=$((moved + 1))
    done
fi
for rel in "${!new[@]}"; do printf '%s  %s\n' "${new[$rel]}" "$rel"; done | sort -k2 > .raptor-pack.new
mv -f .raptor-pack.new .raptor-pack

# ---- Install the mod loader. ----
prev_loader="" prev_launch=""
read -r prev_loader prev_launch 2>/dev/null < .raptor-loader || true
id="$loader-$lver-$mc"
launch=""
if [ "${prev_loader:-}" = "$id" ] && [ -n "${prev_launch:-}" ] && [ -e "${prev_launch##*[@ ]}" ]; then
    launch=$prev_launch
    echo "$Loader $lver is already installed."
else
    echo "Installing $Loader $lver for Minecraft $mc"
    case "$loader" in
        fabric)
            inst=$(get https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/installer | jq -r '[.[] | select(.stable)][0].version')
            vanilla server.jar
            curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$stage/launch.jar" "https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader/$mc/$lver/$inst/server/jar"
            unzip -tq "$stage/launch.jar" >/dev/null || fail "Fabric's server launcher didn't download properly. Reinstall to try again."
            mv -f "$stage/launch.jar" fabric-server-launch.jar
            launch="-jar fabric-server-launch.jar" ;;
        quilt)
            qi=$(get https://meta.quiltmc.org/v3/versions/installer | jq -c '.[0]')
            curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$stage/installer.jar" "$(jq -r .url <<<"$qi")"
            [ "$(sum sha256 "$stage/installer.jar")" = "$(jq -r .hashes.sha256 <<<"$qi")" ] || fail "Quilt's installer didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
            jre
            "$java" -jar "$stage/installer.jar" install server "$mc" "$lver" --download-server --install-dir=. > "$stage/loader.log" 2>&1 ||
                { tail -n 20 "$stage/loader.log"; fail "Quilt's installer failed (above)."; }
            launch="-jar quilt-server-launch.jar" ;;
        forge)
            installer "https://maven.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/$v/forge-$v-installer.jar"
            # Older installers download Minecraft from a link that's gone.
            if older "$mc" 1.17; then vanilla "minecraft_server.$mc.jar"; fi
            jre
            "$java" -jar "$stage/installer.jar" --installServer > "$stage/loader.log" 2>&1 ||
                { tail -n 20 "$stage/loader.log"; fail "Forge's installer failed (above)."; }
            if [ -f "libraries/net/minecraftforge/forge/$v/unix_args.txt" ]; then
                launch="@user_jvm_args.txt @libraries/net/minecraftforge/forge/$v/unix_args.txt"
            else
                for j in "forge-$v.jar" "forge-$v-universal.jar" "forge-$v-shim.jar"; do
                    if [ -f "$j" ]; then launch="-jar $j"; break; fi
                done
            fi ;;
        neoforge)
            installer "https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged/$path/$v/$path-$v-installer.jar"
            jre
            "$java" -jar "$stage/installer.jar" --installServer > "$stage/loader.log" 2>&1 ||
                { tail -n 20 "$stage/loader.log"; fail "NeoForge's installer failed (above)."; }
            [ ! -f "libraries/net/neoforged/$path/$v/unix_args.txt" ] ||
                launch="@user_jvm_args.txt @libraries/net/neoforged/$path/$v/unix_args.txt" ;;
    esac
    [ -n "$launch" ] || fail "$Loader installed, but its server files aren't where they should be."
    [ "${launch#@user_jvm_args.txt}" = "$launch" ] || [ -f user_jvm_args.txt ] ||
        echo "# Extra Java arguments, one per line." > user_jvm_args.txt
    # The previous loader's files, now replaced.
    case "$prev_launch" in
        "$launch") ;;
        "-jar "*) rm -f "${prev_launch#-jar }" ;;
        *unix_args.txt) old_args=${prev_launch##*@}; rm -rf "${old_args%/unix_args.txt}" ;;
    esac
    rm -f run.bat installer.log installer.jar.log ./*-installer.jar.log
    echo "$id $launch" > .raptor-loader
fi
# What the startup command reads: the Java it needs, and how to start it.
echo "$need $max" > .raptor-java
echo "$launch" > .raptor-launch

echo
[ "$updated" = 0 ] && [ "$added" = 0 ] && [ "$removed" = 0 ] || echo "Files: $added added, $updated updated, $removed removed."
[ "$moved" = 0 ] || echo "Moved $moved mods the pack doesn't include to mods.old, so they don't load next to its own."
if [ "${#kept[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "Kept these files you changed instead of the pack's version:"
    printf '  %s\n' "${kept[@]:0:20}"
    [ "${#kept[@]}" -le 20 ] || echo "  and $((${#kept[@]} - 20)) more"
fi
java_text="Java $need"
[ -z "$max" ] || [ "$max" = "$need" ] || java_text="Java $need to $max"
[ -n "$max" ] || java_text="Java $need or newer"
echo "Installed $pack_name $pack_version, for Minecraft $mc with $Loader $lver. It needs $java_text."

variables.name: Modpack ID
variables.description: The pack's ID, the number in its link on FTB's site, such as 126 for FTB Presents Direwolf20 1.21.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The pack version to install, such as 1.23.0, or latest for the newest release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Version ID
variables.description: The version's ID on FTB's site, which picks the version instead of Version when it's set.

variables.name: Search
variables.description: A pack name to look up when Modpack ID is empty; the first match is installed.
